1: // Cosmic Dodge – simple canvas game
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     w: 30,
13:     h: 30,
14:     x: width / 2 - 15,
15:     y: height - 40,
16:     speed: 5,
17:     shield: false,
18:     shieldTimer: 0,
19:     draw() {
20:       ctx.fillStyle = this.shield ? 'cyan' : 'white';
21:       ctx.beginPath();
22:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h);
23:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y);
24:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
25:       ctx.closePath();
26:       ctx.fill();
27:     }
28:   };
29: 
30:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
33: 
34:   const asteroids = [];
35:   const asteroidSpawnRate = 60; // frames
36:   let frameCount = 0;
37:   let score = 0;
38:   let lastTime = performance.now();
39: 
40:   function spawnAsteroid() {
41:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
42:     asteroids.push({
43:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
44:       y: -size,
45:       r: size,
46:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1
47:     });
48:   }
49: 
50:   function update() {
51:     // Move ship
52:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
53:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
54: 
55:     // Update shield timer
56:     if (ship.shield) {
57:       ship.shieldTimer -= 1;
58:       if (ship.shieldTimer <= 0) ship.shield = false;
59:     }
60: 
61:     // Spawn asteroids
62:     if (frameCount % asteroidSpawnRate === 0) spawnAsteroid();
63: 
64:     // Move asteroids and check collisions
65:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
66:       const a = asteroids[i];
67:       a.y += a.speed;
68:       // Remove off‑screen
69:       if (a.y - a.r > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
70:       // Collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
71:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.w, h: ship.h };
72:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x + a.r - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
73:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y + a.r - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
74:       if (distX <= (shipRect.w / 2 + a.r) && distY <= (shipRect.h / 2 + a.r)) {
75:         if (ship.shield) {
76:           asteroids.splice(i, 1); // destroy asteroid
77:         } else {
78:           // Game over
79:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
80:           ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
81:           ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
82:           ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
83:           return;
84:         }
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // Simple power‑up: every 10 seconds grant shield for 3 seconds
89:     if (frameCount % (10 * 60) === 0) {
90:       ship.shield = true;
91:       ship.shieldTimer = 180; // 3 seconds at 60fps
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95:   function draw() {
96:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
97:     // Draw ship
98:     ship.draw();
99:     // Draw asteroids
100:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
101:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.r, a.y + a.r, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:       ctx.fill();
105:     });
106:     // Draw score
107:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
108:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
109:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 30);
110:     // Draw shield indicator
111:     if (ship.shield) {
112:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'cyan';
113:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
114:       ctx.strokeRect(ship.x - 2, ship.y - 2, ship.w + 4, ship.h + 4);
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   function loop(timestamp) {
119:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
120:     lastTime = timestamp;
121:     score += delta / 1000; // seconds
122:     update();
123:     draw();
124:     frameCount++;
125:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
126:   }
127:   let animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
128: })();
